method: Immutable Git-object delta over audited parent counts, using explicit source-reviewed positive cfg spans; not a fresh whole-project category parser.
scope: Tracked rust/**/*.rs only. Nonblank physical lines, including comments. Read WIP, dependencies, caches, documentation and scripts excluded.
classification_notes: Positive cfg(test), cfg(feature="synthetic-authority"), and all/any expressions that require only test/synthetic operation are support. Mixed production-capable conditions and negative synthetic fallbacks remain production.

Support starts at the positive cfg attribute. Comments before that attribute retain their preceding category. Entire externally owned test and synthetic-only modules include their leading comments as support.
Gated struct fields, struct-literal fields, match arms, local statements, expressions and module tails are included, not merely cfg(test) modules. Overlapping nested spans are counted once.
Native lifecycle probe spans are unchanged between these snapshots and have zero effect on this delta. Native/platform gates are not equated with test-only code.
Existing unmodified Rust files inherit the reviewed baseline. Both complete Git trees are independently recounted to verify the total. No completion percentage is inferred.
